description: Gallantt Ispat Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of steel and steel products in India. The company offers pellets, sponge iron, MS billets, and TMT bars; and MIS roll bars, iron ore pellets, and other products. It also provides ordinary portland, portland pozzolana, rapid hardening, sulphate-resistant, white, low-heat, and blended cement. In addition, the company is involved in real estate business; and power generation business. The company sells its products through network of dealers, distributors, directly to the bulk buyers, and participates in auctions of government and non-government organizations. It serves real estate developers, construction industries, government organizations, and corporate. The company was formerly known as Gallantt Metal Limited and changed its name to Gallantt Ispat Limited in June 2022. Gallantt Ispat Limited was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Gorakhpur, India.
